user_story.summary: Profile Setup — Basic Info tab review
user_story.want: to see and manage my business identity fields on the Basic Info tab of /profile
user_story.benefit: I can confirm my display name and primary contact details before going live
acceptance_criteria: Basic Info tab is reachable from /profile
Business / brand display-name field is visible
Primary contact (POC) input fields are present
Save / Save and Next button is available
No error toasts surface while viewing the tab

test_steps.expected: /profile page loads with profile tab strip visible
A business / brand name input is present
At least one POC name input present
Save / Save and Next button is visible
No error / alert toasts on the page

user_story.want: to configure my warehouse operating hours, working days, and holidays under the Operations tab
user_story.benefit: Buyers know when my warehouse can fulfil orders and I can plan around closures
acceptance_criteria: Save / Save and Next button is available

test_steps.expected: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat buttons visible
Add Holiday button or control visible
Save / Save and Next button visible

user_story.want: to upload my regulatory licenses with state, document type, and expiry date on the Compliance tab
user_story.benefit: I can sell regulated categories (pesticides, fertilizers, etc.) without compliance gaps
acceptance_criteria: Document type / category selector is present

user_story.summary: Profile Setup — Business Terms tab review
user_story.want: to configure my credit terms (days and limit) with Agrim on the Business Terms tab
user_story.benefit: Agrim's finance and ordering teams have the correct commercial terms on file
acceptance_criteria: Business Terms tab is reachable from /profile
Credit Limit to Agrim input is present

test_steps.expected: Credit Limit to Agrim input visible
